  "pros": [
    "Excellent security practices & open-source nature.",
    "Generous free tier and affordable premium plans.",

pros: Generous free tier and affordable premium plans.
Self-hosting option for ultimate privacy and control.
Comprehensive feature set including TOTP, secure notes.
Reliable autofill and browser extension integration.
cons: User interface (UI) can feel less polished than competitors.
Occasional autofill inconsistencies on specific websites.
Steeper learning curve for advanced features like self-hosting.
Customer support can be slower or less personalized.
Mobile app experience sometimes lags desktop/browser extensions.
Sharing features, while present, could be more intuitive.
